title: PFRDA & Income Tax Exemption Benefits for National Pension System
source: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) / Income Tax Dept
content: NPS Tier I contributions enjoy triple tax benefits: 1. Section 80CCD(1) deduction up to 10% of salary within overall Section 80C limit of ₹1,50,000. 2. Exclusive Section 80CCD(1B) additional deduction up to ₹50,000. 3. Section 80CCD(2) employer contribution deduction up to 14% of salary for Central Government employees (10% for private sector) available under both Old and New Tax Regimes. At maturity, 60% lump-sum withdrawal is completely tax-exempt under Section 10(12A).
